top_signals.title: Wall Street Preps Debt Deals Using Paramount Blueprint
top_signals.summary: Morgan Stanley expects Skydance’s $52 billion financing to become a model for even larger deals combining investment-grade and junk debt, as bankers anticipate another busy year for acquisition financing. But rising rates are putting pressure on weaker borrowers and private-equity-backed companies facing 2028 and 2029 maturities, prompting calls for private credit to help refinance looming debt. (Source: Bloomberg)
